attr.title: Mega Man Space 2
attr.desc: Mega Man Space 2 is a Mega Man based fangame with a drastic change on the genre, tanking the blue bomber into an arcade-like space action adventure.
attr.inst: Download the Windows version at itch.io https://gaspi.itch.io/mega-man-space-2 and place Mega Man Space 2 - 20w18a.pck into the megamanspace2 folder.
